jurisdiction.name: Generic state fallback (used when a state has no catalog file)
jurisdiction.notes: Every US state has some version of these items. Names, fees and timelines are typical ranges, not the specific state's values.

permits.name: Form your legal entity with the Secretary of State
permits.issuing_agency: State Secretary of State / Division of Corporations
permits.notes: Register an LLC or corporation (or a trade name if operating as a sole proprietor). Needed before the EIN, bank account, lease and any license applications.

permits.name: State sales tax permit / seller's registration
permits.notes: Prepared food and drinks are taxable in nearly every state; register before your first sale. Five states (AK, DE, MT, NH, OR) have no general sales tax but may levy meals or lodging taxes.

permits.name: State employer registration (unemployment insurance + withholding)
permits.issuing_agency: State labor / workforce agency and Department of Revenue
permits.notes: Register for state unemployment insurance and income tax withholding accounts before the first payroll.

permits.name: Workers' compensation insurance
permits.notes: Required in every state except Texas once you have employees (thresholds vary from 1 to 5 employees). Premiums are a percentage of payroll.

permits.name: State alcoholic beverage license (on-premises)
permits.notes: Every state licenses on-premises alcohol sales through an ABC/liquor authority, usually with a local endorsement or public notice period. Beer-and-wine licenses are faster and cheaper than full-liquor; some states cap licenses by population (quota), which forces purchase on a secondary market.
permits.stall_risk: Quota states and local objections can double the timeline; confirm license availability before signing a lease.

permits.name: Certified Food Protection Manager
permits.notes: Most states and the FDA Food Code require at least one certified manager per food establishment; many also require food handler cards for all staff.
